c001.title: Nice to Meet You
c001.story: It is Anna's first week at [[college]] in Kyiv. Tonight there is a [[party]] for new [[students|student]]. A man says, "[[Ladies|lady]] and [[gentlemen|gentleman]], [[welcome]]!" Many [[people]] smile and clap. Anna sees a tall boy alone. She says, "[[Hello|hello]]! I am Anna." He says, "I am Max. [[Nice|nice]] to meet you!" They dance and laugh all night. The music is [[cool]], and the food is [[good]]. At the end, Anna and Max are [[friends|friend]].

c002.title: Lost on the First Day
c002.story: Anna is late on her first day. At the door, she is in [[trouble]]. A guard says, "Your [[ID]], [[please]]." Anna opens her bag and says, "[[Sorry|sorry]], [[sir]]. One [[moment]]." Then she cannot find room twelve. She asks a woman at the desk, "Excuse me, [[Miss]], where is it?" The woman smiles. "It is [[easy]]. Go up and left." Anna says, "[[OK]], thank you!" She gets to class just in time.

c003.title: Tell Me About Yourself
c003.story: After class, Anna and Max sit in the park. Anna asks Max about his [[background]]. He is from Odesa and is still a [[teenager]]. Anna's dad has a small [[business]], a flower shop. Max's [[hobby]] is taking pictures. Winter is Anna's favorite [[season]]. "What [[type]] of music do you like?" asks Max. "Rock! I am a big [[fan]]," says Anna. She likes his [[character]], because he is so [[friendly]]. They swap phone numbers to stay in [[contact]]. Then Max says, "[[Goodbye|goodbye]]! See you tomorrow!"

c004.title: Anna's Photos
c004.story: Anna shows Max her [[photos|photo]] on her phone. The first one is a [[selfie]] at the river. "Who is this?" asks Max. "This is my [[boyfriend]], Oleh." He is six [[feet|foot]] tall, with a kind [[face]]. Next is a girl with long [[blonde]] [[hair]]. That is Anna's cousin Olya. The last picture shows Dima, her [[crazy]] friend. He is always in a good [[mood]]. Max laughs. "Can I meet them all?"

c005.title: A Plan for the Weekend
c005.story: Max has an [[idea]] for the [[weekend]]. "Can you keep a [[secret]]?" he asks Anna. "My [[bro]] can give us his car. We have a [[chance]] to go to Lviv!" Anna smiles. "That is a [[super]] [[plan]]!" It makes [[sense]], because the train is expensive. They talk about the [[details|detail]] over tea. Who drives? Where do they sleep? Now it is a [[fact]]: they leave on Saturday!

c006.title: Lunch at the Cafe
c006.story: Anna and Max have [[lunch]] at a small [[cafe]]. It is near their college. They read the [[menu]]. Max orders [[soup]] and a [[sandwich]]. Anna wants a salad with [[dressing]]. She also takes chicken with [[rice]] and [[sauce]]. The food is hot and very tasty. For [[dessert]], Anna has cake and [[lemon]] tea. Max eats half of her cake!

c007.title: Coffee Before Class
c007.story: Max meets Anna at a [[coffee shop]] before class. The place has a great [[vibe]]. It is full of [[hipsters|hipster]] with laptops. The [[barista]] makes Anna a [[latte]]. It is from a new [[blend]]. Max orders a [[cappuccino]] with [[caramel]]. He tastes it slowly and nods. Anna laughs. "You are a real coffee [[snob]]!" They also take a [[croissant]] and a [[muffin]]. Then they run to class, cups in hand.

c008.title: Pizza Night
c008.story: On Friday, Max wants to [[chill]] at home. Anna and two friends come over. They order a big [[pizza]] for [[delivery]]. "What [[topping]] do we want?" asks Anna. "[[Pepperoni|pepperoni]] and [[mozzarella]]!" says Max. It is huge, with a [[diameter]] of forty centimeters. They also get [[cola]], [[nachos]], and other [[snacks|snack]]. Then Max makes [[popcorn]], and they watch a movie. Soon everybody is asleep on the sofa.

c009.title: At the Burger Place
c009.story: After the cinema, Max wants [[fast food]]. They walk to a small place near the park. Cars wait in line at the [[drive-through]]. But Anna, Max, and his cousin Ihor go inside. Max orders a [[burger]] with [[ketchup]] and [[mayonnaise]]. He also gets a chocolate [[milkshake]]. Anna takes a small [[sundae]]. Ihor is older, so he orders a cold [[lager]]. They eat and talk about the movie. Max has sauce on his nose, and they laugh.

c010.title: Sunday Breakfast
c010.story: On Sunday morning, Anna's mama made a big breakfast. She put bread in the [[toaster]]. Soon there was hot [[toast]] with [[jam]] on the table. Next came [[pancakes|pancake]] with sweet [[syrup]]. Dad cooked [[bacon]] and a cheese [[omelet]]. Anna ate everything and felt very happy. Only her brother Taras was on a diet. He ate just [[yogurt]] and half a [[grapefruit]]. But ten minutes later, his plate was full!

c011.title: At the Supermarket
c011.story: Anna and Max go to the [[supermarket]]. Friends come for dinner tonight. First, they take a [[kilo]] of tomatoes. Then they get two [[liters|liter]] of milk. Max puts [[broccoli]] and an [[avocado]] in the cart. They also take a sweet [[mango]] and four [[kiwis|kiwi]]. Anna loves [[citrus]] fruit, so she adds [[tangerines|tangerine]]. For snacks, they get [[cheddar]], [[salami]], and [[crackers|cracker]]. At the checkout, Max looks at the bill. It is a big dinner!

c012.title: Cooking for a Vegan Friend
c012.story: Anna invited her friend Lisa for dinner. Lisa is a [[vegan]], and she can't eat [[gluten]]. So Anna decided to cook [[tofu]] in a big [[wok]]. She added [[kale]] and [[zucchini]] too. Then she made a [[curry]] with one hot [[chili]]. She also made some [[hummus]] with fresh carrots. Lisa arrived, and they sat down to eat. Suddenly, Lisa smelled something strange. Anna forgot to turn off the [[gas]]! She ran to the kitchen and turned it off. Dinner was almost a [[fiasco]], but the food was great.
